standard_position: Tenant has the right to sublet part or all of the premises to any affiliated company without consent, and to third parties with Landlord consent (not to be unreasonably withheld).
fallback_positions: Subletting is permitted to third parties provided the Tenant remains fully liable for the rent payments.
red_line: Landlord has the right to 'recapture' the space (terminate the lease) if the Tenant asks for permission to sublet.
rationale: The ultimate 'escape hatch.' Startups raising huge rounds need to move; those facing cutbacks need to sublet. This flexibility is vital for survival.
negotiation_tips: Prohibitions on subletting even to parent or subsidiary companies.
